_note: 20 scripted turns for the Phase 1 latency run. voice: macOS `say` voice (Rishi = Indian English, also used for Roman-script Hinglish; Lekha = Hindi). kind: what the model should do (plain = answer, tool = call get_reading). gap_s: silence after the line, long enough for the reply to finish.

turns.text: Hi Benchmate, can you hear me?
What does diode mode measure?
Read the meter please.
बूट करंट क्या होता है?
What does O L mean on the multimeter?
Supply kitna dikha raha hai?
V BAT ka matlab kya hai?
What is the unit of current?
Can you read the supply display?
मल्टीमीटर पर डायोड मोड कैसे लगाते हैं?
What is a short circuit, in one line?
मीटर पढ़ो।
Ruko, ek minute.
ग्राउंड पॉइंट क्या होता है?
I have placed the probes. Read the meter.
Okay, I am back. What is the difference between volts and amps?
Meter padho, probe laga diya hai.
What does the beep in continuity mode mean?
What does the supply show now?
Theek hai, thank you.
